brief: Identify which disclosed annual cost measure and included charges need local interpretation.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Read the annual disclosure"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Lee el indicador anual"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Leia o indicador anual"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify which disclosed annual cost measure and included charges need local interpretation.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: An annual percentage label does not replace the complete repayment schedule.
instruction.misconception: APR, CAT and CET are identical worldwide formulas or guarantee that every possible charge is already included.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: APR uses defined disclosure rules. Check included charges before comparing it with an interest rate or another product.
The annual disclosure can differ from the interest rate.
An excluded chosen service still affects what you pay.
Local disclosure rules can define different included costs and assumptions.
The relevant authority explains the applicable local disclosure rules.
An annual measure does not establish monthly payment feasibility.
Missing scope prevents a defensible comparison between different disclosures.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
